page.overview:
Who is Ashley (Lisa the Boy Scout)?

Ashley is a fan of The Simpsons who along with his Female Counterpart hacked the show showing unaired clips such as Selma admitting she is actually Marge's mother, Homer having turned out to have been dreaming the whole series since falling in a coma after jumping the Springfield Gorge in Springfield Gorge.

He and his female counterpart became couple at the end of the episode. Category:Male characters Category:Non-canon characters

Category:One-time characters Category:Characters debuting in Season 34
